acf.h1_service_page: HARO Link Building That Earns Editorial Authority
acf.h1_paragraph: Real backlinks come from real journalists writing real stories. Rank Ray connects your expertise with reporters who need credible sources, earning editorial links that build lasting authority and referral traffic.
acf.h2_first: High-Impact HARO Link Building That Drives Authority and Rankings
acf.h2_paragraph_1: Most businesses never earn links from major publications because they lack relationships, pitch discipline, or expert positioning. HARO link building bridges that gap by connecting your knowledge with journalists actively seeking sources. Unlike guest posts or directory submissions, these links are editorially earned, making them among the most defensible and valuable backlinks in modern SEO.
acf.h2_paragraph_2:
Build Authority Through Genuine Expertise

We position your team as the go-to source for journalists covering your industry. By monitoring daily reporter requests, crafting compelling pitches, and delivering valuable commentary, we secure placements that generate both referral traffic and lasting domain authority. Every link is editorially earned, contextually relevant, and fully compliant with Google guidelines.

Our HARO link building integrates with digital PR campaigns for sustained media coverage and content marketing to amplify your expertise positioning.
acf.h2_paragraph_3:
Data-Driven HARO Link Building That Delivers Results

At Rank Ray, we understand that not all links are equal. We focus exclusively on placements in publications your audience trusts, optimizing for domain authority, topical relevance, and referral traffic potential. Our team manages the entire HARO process from request filtering to pitch delivery, ensuring your experts spend time only on opportunities worth pursuing.

We reject paid placement offers and sponsored post opportunities. Every link is earned through genuine expertise that adds value to the journalist story. This white-hat approach protects your site from algorithm penalties while building long-term authority that competitors cannot replicate through automation.
acf.h3_portfolio_paragraph_before_3_boxes:
Earn Editorial Links That Build Real Authority

At Rank Ray, our HARO link building strategies connect genuine expertise with journalists who need credible sources. We do not chase link volume. We pursue placements that strengthen your authority profile and drive qualified referral traffic.

We have helped SaaS companies earn coverage in TechCrunch and Entrepreneur, healthcare brands secure features in major medical publications, and B2B services land quotes in Forbes and Business Insider. Each placement builds credibility that compounds over time, creating a backlink profile that outperforms paid link networks and automated outreach.

Our approach combines daily opportunity monitoring, expert pitch crafting, and journalist relationship development. Every campaign is tailored to your industry, expertise areas, and visibility goals.

If you are ready to build authority through editorial coverage, let us talk about a HARO strategy for your brand.

acf.answer_1: HARO link building connects businesses with journalists seeking expert sources. By responding to reporter queries with valuable commentary, you earn editorial backlinks from major publications.
acf.question_2: Are HARO backlinks good for SEO?
acf.answer_2: Yes. HARO links are editorially earned from trusted news sites, making them highly defensible against algorithm updates. They deliver both authority and referral traffic.
acf.answer_3: Absolutely. Any business with genuine expertise can benefit. We help startups and established brands alike position their knowledge for journalist coverage.
acf.answer_4: Most clients see first placements within two to four weeks. Success rates improve as we refine pitch strategies and build journalist familiarity with your brand.
acf.answer_5: Yes. We manage the entire process including opportunity filtering, pitch writing, follow-up communication, and placement tracking. Your team only provides expertise when requested.
acf.answer_6: Responding to journalist queries through HARO is free. Our service covers the labor of monitoring, crafting pitches, and managing relationships at scale.
acf.question_7: How many pitches should I send?
acf.answer_7: We recommend five to ten targeted pitches weekly for consistent opportunities without overwhelming resources. Quality always outperforms quantity in HARO outreach.
acf.answer_8: Media outlets can update articles, but we maintain relationships to address issues and secure replacements when needed. Editorial links typically remain stable long term.
acf.question_9: What if my pitch gets rejected?
acf.answer_9: Rejection is normal in HARO outreach. We analyze feedback, refine messaging, and adjust targeting to improve success rates with each campaign cycle.
acf.answer_10: Fill out our form and we will schedule a strategy call to plan your campaign. We analyze your niche, identify expertise angles, and build a custom outreach plan.
